thesis: AFTER-HOURS (17:00 ET) read with the completed Friday 2026-08-14 close (SPY 776.34) now the LAST COMPLETED daily bar, planning Monday 2026-08-17 (a weekend gap sits between this read and the next session). WHAT CHANGED ON THE COMPLETED BAR: SPY closed 776.34 (pctFrom52wHigh -0.2), essentially flat and just under the fresh 8/13 high (777.88), still holding its multi-month 20>50>200 bull-stack (+3.71% over its 50-day ~748.6, +10.47% over its 200-day ~702.8, mom126/252 +14.56%/+21.72%; swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked, Double bottom pattern-qualified), and intraday-tape-lab reads the full 8/14 session a Mixed / developing auction under Algo-controlled control (VWAP 776.63, gap +0.1%, 79 bars) — an orderly, indecisive close, not a break. But the breadth premise DETERIORATED: market-heatmap-lab reads the completed 8/14 bar at 51.05% of 134 constituents positive against the 60% threshold (NARROW, margin -8.95), so the 8/13 65.06% reclaim proved a one-bar spike and completed-bar breadth has slipped back below the line (sequence 60.25% on 8/10, 56.47% on 8/11, 49.85% on 8/12, 65.06% on 8/13, 51.05% on 8/14) — three-bar persistence is not met and the second qualifying bar the pre-close plan waited for did not arrive. The dealer cushion is intact but thinner again: options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab (asOf 2026-08-14T15:59:59Z, dealer spot 775.95) read SPY in POSITIVE dealer gamma with the flip DOWN at 769.1 and the spot above it, signed net GEX +5.93B (down from the pre-close +8.47B and the morning +11.98B), put wall 775, call wall 780, atmIV 5.94% (below the calm headline VIX 14.25) and a front expected move of ±1.71 (~±0.22%) — so dealers still dampen and pin, but SPY sits at the LOWER edge of the 775-780 range, on the 775 put wall. Flow flipped BACK to call-heavy: options-flow-feed-lab reads callFraction 0.6696 (call premium $2.24B against $1.11B of put premium across 12 tickers, 1804 contracts clearing the $250k premium bar), and its top prints are all calls — TSLA 340 CALLS at $67.7M on 15.4x open interest (0DTE), QQQ 730 CALLS at $45.1M (0DTE) and AMD 505 CALLS at $43.9M (0DTE) — with no index-put tell this window. volatility-sizing-lab holds a NORMAL regime (SPY conditional vol 12.859%, throttle x1.17, percentile 54.2), and headline VIX is a calm 14.25. Rotation stays risk-on and is now cleaner: sector-research-lab reads Rotate toward XLK as XLE weakens, and XLK is BOTH the highest relative-strength name AND now Leading (rsMom 102.37, rsRatio 100.01, accel +2.55, quad L, +20.82% over its 200-day), funded from weakening energy/health/financials/industrials (XLE/XLV/XLF/XLI, all quad W) while XLY/XLP/XLRE lag (quad A) and XLU bases. etf-momentum-lab ranks VGT first (34.68%, balanced) with SPMO 30.19 and QQQ 22 behind; global-rotation-lab keeps EWS Singapore first (89, strong uptrend) with EWC Canada next; real-assets-lab keeps copper CPER the outright lead (53.3) with GLD 38.2, BTC 34.9 and SLV 14.1 below (an industrial-metals tilt, no dominant precious-metal haven; GLD 401.48 is tangled, -2.64% under its 200-day). bond-regime-lab still cannot make the credit or duration call this run — an independent credit-spread reading is not available in this view yet — but its high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio reads strengthening through 8/14 on both aligned pairs (JNK/LQD and HYG/LQD), a mild risk-on credit tell, with the yield curve positive. company-fundamentals-lab (MSFT) is partial with no direction available in this view yet (statement 2026-03-31, stale and pre-print); ai-capex-strategy-lab returns only a dated 2026-06-30 scenario-assumptions estimate, not measured returns; technical-analysis-decision-lab published only its data foundation and its owner five-gate model does not feed the brief yet; fx-regime-relative-value-lab withheld every currency family for lack of an approved source, so it is not applicable this window; and msft-july-print-model, smart-money-flow-lab, strategy-self-improvement-lab, strategy-validation-lab, trend-dynamics-cycle-lab, waterfront-polo-lab, palm-springs-rental-market-lab, ocean-shores-rental-market-lab and portfolio-survival-allocation-lab made no call this cycle. PLAN, structure-first and a touch more cautious than the pre-close because the breadth gate failed: HOLD the structural SPY/SPMO core — the 20>50>200 bull-stack is intact and SPMO holds above its 50-day (~150.5) with mom21 positive. HOLD the FIRST measured beta-add tranche but keep the remaining tranches gated and PAUSED — completed-bar breadth fell back to 51.05% (narrow), so do not add into a narrowing tape; release the rest only when a completed close re-reclaims and holds breadth above 60% while SPMO holds above ~150.5 and SPY holds above the 769.1 flip. ROTATE toward XLK (now both the highest-rsMom name and Leading, rotating in), funded from weakening energy/health/financials/industrials (XLE/XLV/XLF/XLI), keeping XLY/XLP/XLRE/XLU OUT. HOLD MSFT (495.40, maStack still tangled, mom252 -4.08 still negative) and do NOT chase the extended gap. On the hedge: dealers hold a positive-gamma pin above the 769.1 flip and atmIV stays below the headline, but the cushion has thinned to +5.93B, SPY sits on the 775 put wall, completed-bar breadth has slipped back below 60% and a weekend gap sits ahead, so carry a LIGHT residual tail over the weekend while breadth is back below the line and the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed path stay unverified, and retire it on a close that clears the 780 call wall with VIX under ~14.5. Open risk into 8/17 and over the weekend: 8/14 had no scheduled high-importance release, the next scheduled item is the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28, and the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed statement/path remain re-pull items.
